title: Shapeshift Studio feature catalogue
description: Shared discovery data for Studio Core, the web editor, offline CLI, live API and generated documentation.
schemaNote: Recipe inputSchema values are JSON Schema 2020-12. They describe validated recipe inputs; the advanced command index is an inventory, not a full schema for every project payload.

features.title: Projects and portable files
features.description: Create projects, edit joints and clips, save portable JSON, and undo or redo changes.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Agent API and CLI
features.description: Inspect a live editor, discover controls, apply atomic command batches and export artifacts through the same project store.
requirements: Discovery works offline. Editing requires npm start and an open editor tab.
limitations: The CLI targets an existing browser session; choose --session when several tabs are open.

codeExamples.title: Discover offline, then connect
codeExamples.code:
npm run studio -- catalog
npm run studio -- catalog --query liquid
npm run studio -- catalog liquid
npm run studio -- recipe add-liquid --json '{"joint":"body","fill":0.7}'
npm run studio -- sessions
npm run studio -- capabilities

features.title: Keyframes and easing
features.description: Animate rest-relative joint transforms with smooth, stepped, elastic, bounce or custom Bezier interpolation.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Shared timeline
features.description: Inspect tracks and retime transform, constraint, speech, drawing and sound keys together.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Motion layers and secondary motion
features.description: Author contacts, look targets, follow motion, masked clip layers, pose offsets, smears and morphs.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Procedural 2D rigs
features.description: Build ropes, spines, tentacles, soft bodies and walking rigs with particles, constraints, collisions, support and dynamic ink surfaces.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.
limitations: 2D rigs can render on a puppet plane in 3D; spatial locomotion is a separate feature.

features.title: Procedural 3D locomotion
features.description: Plan stepping, reaching and following chains over terrain, including body support, target movement and tracking.
requirements: A 3D scene and a procedural rig configuration.

features.title: Noodle deformation
features.description: Bend artwork and geometry around a continuous spine with stretch, twist, lag, overshoot and volume preservation.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.
limitations: SVG baking requires editable vector artwork; use rendered export for artwork meshes.

features.title: Artwork meshes
features.description: Create grids or custom contours, triangulate artwork, animate vertices and paint bone weights.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.
limitations: Unbind and remove mesh keys before changing topology.

features.title: SVG bone binding
features.description: Bind SVG points and independent Bezier handles to bones with normalized weights.
requirements: Editable SVG artwork and control joints.

features.title: Constraints and inverse kinematics
features.description: Constrain translation, rotation, scale, transform or distance, and solve 2D IK chains with animated influence.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.
limitations: IK chain authoring is 2D; transform and distance constraints also support 3D.

examples.title: Open Constraints and inverse kinematics example

features.title: Follow Path
features.description: Move and orient a joint along an editable SVG path with keyed distance and constraint strength.
requirements: An editable SVG path target in the 2D rig.
limitations: Warped, cropped, sliced and procedural-bound path targets are not supported; point morphs and SVG bone binding are supported.

features.title: Pose joysticks
features.description: Drive two source timelines with an animated handle, a world-space target or nested joystick controls.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.
limitations: Sources must not claim the same property. Joysticks control 2D rigs, including their 3D puppet instances.

features.title: Solo drawing swaps
features.description: Show one child branch at a time using default choices and held animation keys.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Animated draw order
features.description: Move drawable branches in front of or behind other artwork without changing joint parents.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Animation state machines
features.description: Connect clips with boolean, number and trigger inputs, conditional transitions and layered pose blending.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.
limitations: The editor state-machine preview is silent; clip visuals use the dominant animation.

features.title: Soft body joins
features.description: Join overlapping puppet parts with silhouette-aware deformation and paint continuity.
requirements: Overlapping artwork parts and an explicit target joint or solid body.

features.title: SVG artwork editor
features.description: Edit paths and Bezier handles, colours, gradients, swatches, shape order, booleans and point animation.
requirements: Open SVG artwork in the Artwork workspace.

features.title: Animated path trimming
features.description: Reveal or offset stroked paths by length, with synced or sequential contour timing.
requirements: Editable SVG paths with a visible stroke.

features.title: Vector clipping
features.description: Clip artwork to other vector shapes, including inversion and animated clip sources.
requirements: Editable SVG artwork containing source and target shapes.

features.title: N-slicing and outline detection
features.description: Resize artwork while preserving corners and selected regions; recognize outlines for deformation workflows.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Shape Lab
features.description: Combine implicit fields into editable contours, SVG animations or 3D meshes and mesh sequences.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Illustration motion and folds
features.description: Add line boil, edge treatment, pose-driven drawing corrections, motion fields, receivers and 3D bend regions.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.
limitations: Boil needs editable SVG artwork. Fold regions need a 3D object.

examples.title: Open Illustration motion and folds example

features.title: Container liquid and potion sounds
features.description: Animate a sealed liquid surface with area-preserving fill, slosh, damping, viscosity, colour, bubbles and optional sound presets.
requirements: A 2D puppet joint with a container boundary.
limitations: This is a sealed 2D spring-surface model, not a general 3D fluid solver.

examples.title: Open Container liquid and potion sounds example

features.title: Colour shifts and effect bindings
features.description: Animate hue or tint while protecting ink, and bind illustration channels to runtime effect data.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Recorded speech and lip sync
features.description: Place recordings on a timeline with visemes, coarticulation, facial poses, drawing swaps and envelope-driven motion.
requirements: A recording, timed cues and a facial rig mapping.
limitations: Studio schedules supplied recordings. Optional voice-generation scripts need your own provider credentials.

examples.title: Open Recorded speech and lip sync example

features.title: 3D facial animation
features.description: Drive expression, blinks, gaze and eye landmarks independently from body animation.
requirements: A 3D node with compatible authored face surfaces and eye landmarks.

features.title: Illustrated 3D scenes
features.description: Build scenes from primitives, SVG planes, extrusions, lathes, meshes and 2D puppet instances; animate transforms and camera settings.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Materials, surfaces and ink outlines
features.description: Author illustrated shading, paint-preserving surfaces, freehand outlines, bevels, surface detail and face artwork.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Dice and regular solids
features.description: Create regular solids and dice geometry, with face artwork and a bundled physics example.
requirements: Open the Scene workspace, then Dice / solid.

features.title: Lighting and glowing artwork
features.description: Attach lights to joints or scene objects and animate tint, emission, range and environment light.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Particles
features.description: Author particle emitters and key their parameters for sparks, dust and atmospheric effects.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Fluid fields and vector contours
features.description: Author 2D fluid effects with surface tension and vector contour rendering.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Compositing and presentation cues
features.description: Connect effect nodes, key numeric parameters and add timed flashes, shake, hitstop and other presentation cues.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Colour grading
features.description: Apply scene-wide colour presets and grading controls after lighting, shadows and effects.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Backgrounds and parallax
features.description: Layer, order and animate scene backdrops independently from the puppet.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Sound design
features.description: Author sound libraries and timed cues, including procedural synthesis and liquid sound presets.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Reusable component library
features.description: Capture and place reusable puppets, motion and other components with dependency remapping and explicit source updates.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Appearance roles and variants
features.description: Bind semantic colour roles, switch variants and apply consistent styling to artwork.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Entities and component schemas
features.description: Define component schemas, entity templates and references for application-defined state.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Data-defined behaviours and attached effects
features.description: Run component operations and timed state transitions, and bind transforms, attachments, beams and effects to controller state.
requirements: Entity definitions, a controller library and scene node bindings.

features.title: Reusable actions
features.description: Capture parameterized animation actions and instantiate them on other targets.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Property ownership and resolved channels
features.description: Inspect competing animation sources, key handovers, and bake resolved properties for predictable playback.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Gesture recording
features.description: Record interactive edits into animation tracks and simplify captured keys.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Preview scenarios and references
features.description: Compare poses and clips in preview scenarios and save references for review.
requirements: Open an editor project to author this feature.

features.title: Rendering and exports
features.description: Export portable projects, runtime modules, HTML players, SVG artwork, PNGs, GIFs, sprite sheets and frame archives.
requirements: Load all artwork and select a clip before rendering.
limitations: Video assembly uses an external encoder such as ffmpeg; it is not an MP4 export option in the live API.

features.title: Image to SVG
features.description: Convert raster artwork into layered vector paths using the optional native Node pipeline.
requirements: Node.js and the optional native vectorizer dependencies.
limitations: This is a Node API, not a browser-only image conversion service.

codeExamples.title: Convert a local PNG (Node)

features.title: Video to tracked SVG
features.description: Convert video frames into temporally tracked vector artwork, with palette, motion and outline controls.
requirements: For conversion: Node.js, optional native dependencies, ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH; run npm run serve:video.
limitations: The normal editor server opens existing vector clips; conversion uses the dedicated local service, default port 8791.

codeExamples.title: Start the conversion service
codeExamples.code:
npm run build
npm run serve:video
# Open http://127.0.0.1:8791/studio/puppet-studio/video-vectorizer/

features.title: Runtime foundations
features.description: Import focused math, geometry, vector rendering, deformation and validation modules without loading the editor.
requirements: Install Studio Core; renderer modules use the Three.js peer dependency.
